turnos.mensaje: How long does standard shipping usually take?
Standard shipping at Nerds Store usually takes 2 to 4 business days.
Does standard shipping apply to orders outside the US too, or only domestic ones?

Nerds Store does not offer international shipping, so standard shipping is only available for orders within the supported domestic area. I don't have further details about which specific regions are covered, so if you need that information, you can contact support at support@nerdsstore.example.
Got it, thanks. Do you know if there's an extra fee for standard shipping, or is it free on all orders?

The knowledge base doesn't list a fee for standard shipping, but it does say that orders reaching the free shipping threshold of $75 qualify for free shipping. I don't have details on the shipping charge for orders below that amount, so for that, please contact support@nerdsstore.example.
Actually, changing the subject completely: does the Webcam C3 support 1080p and how does it connect?
Yes, the Webcam C3 supports 1080p video, and it connects through USB-A.
Nice, thanks. Does it come with a privacy shutter or any built-in mic? I'm mostly asking because I do a lot of calls from my desk.
I'm sorry, but the knowledge base doesn't include information about a privacy shutter or a built-in microphone for the Webcam C3. For those details, please contact support@nerdsstore.example.
Alright, thanks for the help. I think that covers what I needed for now, so I'll go ahead and look into the Webcam C3 a bit more before deciding. Appreciate it!
You're welcome! Good luck with your decision on the Webcam C3. If you have more questions later, feel free to ask.
